question: How many years of service is the IMD celebrating in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**150 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** is celebrating its **sesquicentennial year** (150 years) of service to the nation in **2025**.
 
• Established in **1875**, the **IMD** is one of the oldest scientific institutions in **India**, and it will complete **150 years** of its existence on **January 15, 2025**.
 
• The year-long celebrations for this milestone were officially inaugurated by the **Vice President of India**, **Jagdeep Dhankhar**, on **January 15, 2024**, at **Vigyan Bhawan**, **New Delhi**.
 
• The **IMD** functions under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES)** of the **Government of India** and is the principal agency responsible for meteorological observations, weather forecasting, and seismology.
